text: The Jean Floc'h brand on the FC Lorient shirt belongs to the groupe Jean Floc'h, the French pork-processing group: its site is edited by 'Jean Floc'h' (RCS Lorient B 384 980 165, capital 1,000,000 EUR), and Michel Boulaire is président du groupe JEAN FLOC'H, having taken over at the founder's death in 2007.
short: Jean Floc'h is the brand of the family-led groupe Jean Floc'h, headed by Michel Boulaire.
